how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stranglethorn-vale-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:615:details:0: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another. Named Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains. I found them, but...they beat me. They smashed Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.
rows.quest:615:details:1: BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.
rows.quest:615:details:2: BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!
rows.quest:615:details:3: BSpeak with Sprogger. He was my cook on the Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, and survived the last attack. He can help you find the giant.
rows.quest:615:completion:0: Hello hello, ⟦1⟧. Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?
rows.quest:616:obj:0: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:616:details:0: Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say.
rows.quest:616:details:1: BIf you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?
rows.quest:616:completion:0: Interesting. Some time ago, I seem to remember reading a book once that suggested...
rows.quest:616:completion:1: BAh, of course, a troll legend it was. If what Krazek reports is true, perhaps I will soon be able to add the Stone of the Tides to my collection of ancient artifacts and relics.
rows.quest:617:obj:0: Bring 10 Bundles of Akiris Reed to Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:617:details:0: You looking fer work, ⟦2⟧? I might have some if you're up for a little challenge.
rows.quest:617:details:1: BI got a friend named ⟦E2⟧ who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff.
rows.quest:617:details:2: BYa bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.
rows.quest:617:completion:0: Well done, ⟦3⟧. 10 stalks of akiris reed wasn't too much a challenge after all, huh? No offense to the naga, but hey, everybody's gotta make a living.
rows.quest:618:obj:0: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
rows.quest:618:obj:1: BKill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:618:details:1: BWhen the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the ⟦E3⟧ for the recipe!
rows.quest:618:details:2: BIf you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
rows.quest:618:completion:0: You got my cutlass from Negolash! I can't believe my fortune, ⟦4⟧! Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!
rows.quest:618:completion:1: BThank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
rows.quest:621:obj:0: Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:621:details:0: Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwal and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay. He is exiled from his tribe. Why? Well...
rows.quest:621:details:1: BZanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him. He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.
rows.quest:621:details:2: BHis mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.
rows.quest:621:details:3: BBring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.
rows.quest:621:completion:0: Ah, very good! Here is your pay.
rows.quest:621:completion:1: BAnd here is a little something extra... for your discretion.
rows.quest:622:obj:0: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:622:details:0: While you were gone I fixed the pot you brought me. I even added an extra steam whistle, and look! There's a new chopper at the bottom that'll cut through leg bones!
rows.quest:622:details:1: BYes yes, Krazek's Crock Pot is a 100% cook pleaser! I'm sure its owner will be satisfied.
rows.quest:622:completion:0: It's fixed! This is great, now I can get dinner started! Thanks so much, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:622:completion:1: BI hope you were okay in Booty Bay. That place can get pretty rough, and... I heard rumors that the goblins will sometimes drag drunk sailors to their slave boats and take them to who-knows-where... to do who-knows-what...
rows.quest:623:obj:0: Bring a Bundle of Akiris Reeds to Privateer ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:623:details:0: ⟦6⟧, since I have you here, I got a message from ⟦E2⟧ while you were gone. He mentioned bein' satisfied with the last shipment that arrived and has a client that wants some more of the stuff right away.
rows.quest:623:details:1: BI won't be headin' to ⟦E4⟧ for a week, but if you're willin' to make the journey, there's no reason you can't take the stuff for me.
rows.quest:623:details:2: BFeeling adventurous? You do know where ⟦E5⟧ is, doncha? I'd be careful though, ⟦E4⟧ can be dangerous if you're the wrong kind of crowd.
rows.quest:623:completion:0: What?! I got a lot better things to do then talk to the likes of you, ⟦7⟧. Make it worth my while or get outta my face.
rows.quest:623:completion:1: BHuh? Bloads sent ya, huh? Well, whaddaya got for me?
rows.quest:623:completion:2: B<Privateer ⟦E2⟧ looks over the bundle carefully.>
rows.quest:623:completion:3: BNot bad, not bad at all. Another bundle will make my client quite happy.
rows.quest:623:completion:4: BI suppose yer next question's gonna be about money, huh, ⟦8⟧? Of course it is!
rows.quest:623:completion:5: BHere, take this coin and some advice: get off my docks.
rows.quest:624:details:0: There is an ornate, well-traveled bridge⟦9⟧East of Deadwind and south of Redridge⟦10⟧Underneath there waits something for you⟦11⟧Some call it a hint, others a clue⟦12⟧There it will lie for endless tomorrows⟦13⟧Biding its time in the ⟦E6⟧
rows.quest:624:completion:0: The soggy parchment contains the next clue....
rows.quest:625:details:0: A far off land in ⟦E7⟧ awaits⟦14⟧Where peril has dashed hopes and fates⟦15⟧East of ⟦E8⟧ the weather is harsh⟦16⟧Gloom and danger pock ⟦E5⟧⟦17⟧But there lies a clue for those up to the test⟦18⟧Waiting to be found in a cave in the southwest
rows.quest:626:details:0: To Lordaeron! The great land of turmoil⟦19⟧Where brave soldiers with death do toil⟦20⟧Find your way through the great unrest⟦21⟧There you will find the end to this quest⟦22⟧Along the coast of the Hinterlands, at the base of the great falls⟦23⟧Underneath the water there does your treasure call!
rows.quest:626:completion:0: You open the chest to discover....
rows.quest:627:obj:0: Bring 4 loads of Lesser Bloodstone Ore to Krazek in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:627:details:0: There is a mountain cave in Drywhisker Gorge, far to the north in the ⟦E9⟧. In that cave is rare ore: bloodstone. The bloodstone in this cave is not of the highest grade, but even low-quality bloodstone is valuable... to those with the knowledge to use it.
rows.quest:627:details:2: BI will fix your crock pot, but while I work on it... bring me samples of bloodstone. Bring me enough, and I'll even give you a bonus.
rows.quest:627:details:3: BOh, and if you don't have the skill to mine it... find someone who does!
rows.quest:627:completion:0: Ah, splendid! That was a big favor you did for me.
rows.quest:628:obj:0: Bring an Elder Crocolisk Skin to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:628:details:0: With the inside finished, all that's left is to add the outer layer. For this, I use only the best elder croc skins. They are more durable and a better canvas--if you will--for adding the designs and accents that make Drizzlik's Excelsior line.
rows.quest:628:details:1: BIt's hard to find that perfect skin though, the only one that fits my plan is the skin of an elder saltwater crocolisk. The elders only come out to defend the other saltwater crocs, so you might need to kill a few to draw one out.
rows.quest:628:completion:0: Great! Thanks to your help I'll have this order filled and sent off to Director Riddlevox on the next boat to Undermine. Ahead of schedule, even!
rows.quest:628:completion:1: BFor all your hard work, here, I made some extras, so take a pair. It's on Drizzlik.
rows.quest:628:completion:2: BAnd remember, there's no boot so fine as one of Drizzlik's Excelsior line!
rows.quest:629:obj:0: Bring a Tablet Shard to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:629:details:0: Long ago, a great shudder of the earth sunk an old troll city beneath the waters of the Savage Coast to the northwest. We call that place the Vile Reef, for murlocs now reside in the ruins of the city, attacking any who draw close.
rows.quest:629:details:1: BThere is an old tablet among those ruins that tells the ancient tale of Gri'lek, a hero of troll legends. The tale is sacred to the ⟦E10⟧ tribe, and although the tablet is too large to move, I want a shard of it to enshrine in our new home in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:629:completion:0: This is good. When I return to ⟦E11⟧ I will place this shard in a sacred place. It will remind us of the might and honor of Gri'lek.
rows.quest:629:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦24⟧. Your deeds mark a growing friendship with the ⟦E10⟧ tribe.
rows.quest:630:obj:0: Slay King Mukla and return to Princess Poobah with the Key to free her.
rows.quest:630:details:0: ⟦25⟧, I put my faith in you and anyone you can muster to help free me. The great Skymane King Mukla is my captor. He commands the beasts of this island, and they keep me here against my will with the aid of this chain. If you can slay him and find the key to this shackle, I shall be indebted to you greatly.
rows.quest:630:details:1: BI often hear him to the southeast side of the island, but please be careful: he is not to be trifled with.
rows.quest:630:completion:0: ⟦26⟧, you have saved me from a great dishonor. If it was within my power, I would offer you a place among my tribe. But for now, all I can only offer you is this token for the courage and nobility you have shown.
rows.quest:638:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ to Hammerfall in the ⟦E9⟧ and speak with Zengu.
rows.quest:638:details:0: With Thoras Trollbane dead and Stromgarde in ruins, Vol'jin has instructed that we make every effort to spirit the legendary sword Trol'kalar from the humans' hands, so that we might use it in our coming battles against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:638:details:1: BZengu, one of our seasoned hunters, was dispatched to Hammerfall in northeastern ⟦E9⟧ to oversee its procurement.
rows.quest:638:completion:0: How you doing, ⟦27⟧? The task set before us by Vol'jin will be a difficult one, and any assistance you might provide will be appreciated and necessary.
rows.quest:1036:obj:0: Speak with Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Vale off the coast of ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1036:details:0: ⟦28⟧... yeah, I've heard of you. I've heard that you're no friend of Booty Bay - just like us Bloodsail Buccaneers. Fleet Master Firallon is looking for hale and hearty ⟦29⟧ just like you for a special mission.
rows.quest:1036:details:1: BIf you're interested, head on out to the Crimson Veil and speak with him below decks. She's anchored off the Wild Coast east of here, next to the ⟦E14⟧ and the Damsel's Luck.
rows.quest:1036:completion:0: Avast ye, scallywag. I hears that ye be the type for a bit o' the skullduggery. Well, if yer no friend of Booty Bay, then ye might have a special place with the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
rows.quest:3625:obj:0: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
rows.quest:3625:details:0: ⟦30⟧, the creation of each weapon will take some time.
rows.quest:3625:details:1: BAdditionally, you may only use the power of the Felcurse once per three minutes. Its weakening properties against Razelikh the Defiler and his minions may be variable in duration. This is why you must release the Felcurse only when the moment is right!
rows.quest:3625:details:2: BNow give me a moment to craft your weapon, ⟦31⟧.⟦32⟧
rows.quest:3625:completion:0: <Galvan wipes the sweat from his brow.>
rows.quest:3625:completion:1: BA finer demon slayer has never existed, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:3626:obj:0: Return to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:3626:details:0: The hour of redemption is near, ⟦34⟧. You must return to the ⟦E16⟧ with your new-found weaponry and speak with the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E15⟧ to receive your final objective.⟦35⟧
rows.quest:3626:completion:0: You look battle hardened, ⟦36⟧. Are you prepared to face Razelikh and his minions?
rows.quest:4621:obj:0: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:4621:details:0: Listen close, sea dawg... the powers of Booty Bay is what keeps us Bloodsail from sailing wheres we like and taking whats we want as rights o' plunder. Were ye to put a knife to Fleet Master Seahorn, we'd ne'er run afoul of a Booty Bay's vessel. Were ye to put a knife to Baron Revilgaz, we'd ne'er face the law on their terms.
rows.quest:4621:details:1: BIf ye are to be an honorary admiral amongst us - yes, ADMIRAL, you'll puts a knife to both of 'em as I've says. Go now ⟦37⟧, and return to me once ye does the deeds.
rows.quest:4621:completion:0: Avast ye... Admiral ⟦38⟧! Yer a pirate of pirates, lass!
rows.quest:4621:completion:1: BIt warms the cackles of me heart to give ye this hat. Ye will ne'er find one like it anywheres, and all that gazes upon ye will see that yer an Admiral of the Bloodsail Navy!
rows.quest:7810:obj:0: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.
rows.quest:7810:details:0: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this! Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!
rows.quest:7810:completion:0: Arr Me Hearty! Gaining one Trinket be not enough to make ye master of the Arena! Now tis the time to truly prove your steel.
rows.quest:8551:obj:0: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:8551:details:0: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in ⟦E7⟧. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.
rows.quest:8551:details:2: BThose cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. The nerve!
rows.quest:8551:details:3: BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
rows.quest:8551:completion:0: You found it! Oh happy day, this is! Thank you, ⟦39⟧. Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.
rows.quest:8552:obj:0: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.
rows.quest:8552:details:0: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.
rows.quest:8552:completion:0: You recovered my sash? Then... you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant! Hooray!
rows.quest:8552:completion:1: BI'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew.
rows.quest:8553:details:0: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another. Named Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains. I found them, but...they beat me. They smashed Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.
rows.quest:8553:details:1: BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.
rows.quest:8553:details:2: BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!
rows.quest:8553:details:3: BSpeak with Sprogger. He was my cook on the Smotts' ⟦E1⟧, and survived the last attack. He can help you find the giant.
rows.quest:8553:completion:0: Hello hello, ⟦42⟧. Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?
rows.quest:8554:obj:0: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
rows.quest:8554:obj:1: BKill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:8554:details:1: BWhen the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the ⟦E3⟧ for the recipe!
rows.quest:8554:details:2: BIf you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
rows.quest:8554:completion:0: You got my cutlass from Negolash! I can't believe my fortune, ⟦43⟧! Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!
rows.quest:8554:completion:1: BThank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
rows.quest:9272:completion:0: Yarrr... if ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard! Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide.
rows.quest:9272:completion:1: BThese'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben. Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea.
